dsh-whale-galgame 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

posts.en:
dsh-whale-galgame is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d86381e29b47a3f44cf4.html
